data.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Backend & Applied AI
data.about: I lead backend and AI platform engineering across multiple products. I build and scale distributed systems, design production LLM workflows, and manage teams that ship reliably under real-world constraints.My experience spans startups and global tech companies, where I’ve taken systems from zero to production while balancing performance, cost, and long-term maintainability.

subComponents.title: Principal Software Engineer, Backend & Applied AI
subComponents.caption: Jan 2026 - Present ·

description.text: Leading backend and AI systems across products. Managing the team, defining architecture, and shipping production LLM workflows with structured context management, model evaluation, guardrails, observability, and strong cost controls.

Leading the Backend and Infrastructure team at Fitbod, where I balance hands-on development with guiding DevOps and backend engineers. I design, build, and maintain backend services while improving infrastructure for scalability and reliability. Regularly collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with product goals.

I lead the Go backend team at Fitbod. We design, build, and maintain critical backend services that power the Fitbod apps for millions of users. 

Some of my personal contributions include:
- Building the unified subscription backend which handles all payment logic across Web, iOS, and Android. The service integrates with Stripe/Google/Apple and exposes a cohesive API for all clients to consume. We manage +20M$ ARR and millions of unique transactions.

- Building a new workout metric service that ingests +100k workouts per day and provides our users with timely reports about their performances.

- Managing and mentoring a team of two junior engineers.

InVision is a world leader in digital product design, workflow, and collaboration software.

As an engineer on the product team, I worked on several high profile features such as the homepage, document search, document sharing, permissions and user migration.

- Built and scaled multiple Golang and NodeJS services around document sharing, commenting, and  mentions.
- Successfully Lead several cross-team/cross-geography initiatives.
- Defined and built the team's observability practices: metrics, dashboards, logging, alerts, OPS review meetings, etc...
- Elevated the quality standards in my team by introducing a culture of testing, which was lacking when I joined. I built several testing tools to accomplish this goal.
- Built a man in the middle proxy that sat in between our micro-services and allowed inspection and overriding of requests/responses, a huge time saver for the entire engineering department.

When I Work is the leading employee scheduling, shift planning and time clock app in the US.

I lead the attendance team and we were responsible for features such as time-tracking, labor management, and payroll integrations. As a tech lead, I also acted as the technical point of contact with customer care, sales, and QA.

description.text:
The Nerdery is the leading software consultancy in Minneapolis. I worked on and lead multiple projects from the initial requirement gathering to the production deployment. 

A few notable projects:
- Helped Purina, The largest account we had at the time, rewrite Petfinder.com from a Pearl monolith to a modern service-based architecture. A multi-million dollar engagement.
- Helped webpt.com, the leading physical therapy SaaS business in the US, migrate all their services from PHP 5.3 to 5.6. Their multiple teams had tried and failed for several years and I was brought in to help. I Delivered the project within a few months. This solidified our relationship with WebPT and we
gained several long term projects with them afterwards.

Keyrus is one of the leading digital agencies in Paris, France. In a typical agency fashion.  I worked on a variety of projects and technologies. Some of my duties:

- Lead an offshore team in the design and implementation of web projects.
- Wrote technical documentation and automated tests.
- Ensured good coding practices and adherence to standards.
- Acted as technical point of contact with clients.
- Estimated project efforts and educated clients.

Using a mix of proprietary call center technology and open source VoIP software, I Built a SaaS product for multi-channel marketing campaign management. Features included contact management(import, error detection, deduplication) and campaign management(Creation, targeting, scheduling).

This was my first position out of college and it was very challenging and rewarding. I had to design and build a functioning SaaS product based on nothing but a vague idea.
I owned everything from Requirement gathering to Linux Server administration.
The project was never released due to a lack of vision and resources but I learned quite a lot!
